theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_cp_disjointify
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid P) (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid N)), (∀ j, Continuous (ψ j)) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j)) → (∀ j, InjOn (ψ j) (Y j)) → ∃ Y' : ℕ → Set (Euclid N), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y' j) ∧ Y' j ⊆ Y j) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y' i) (ψ j '' Y' j)) ∧ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y' j = ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j
